subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: WordPress: Powering the Web
description: A fast breakdown of WordPress: Powering the Web for builders.

hook.text: Matt Mullenweg was 19 when he forked a blogging tool and created WordPress in 2003.

buildup.text: Themes and plugins let non-developers build professional websites without writing code.

discovery.text: WordPress powers over 40% of all websites on the internet — from blogs to Fortune 500 sites.

twist.text: WordPress is open source. No company owns it. A nonprofit foundation stewards the project.

climax.text: WordPress democratized publishing more than any technology since the printing press.

punchline.text: A teenager's project runs 40% of the web.

quiz.question: What percentage of websites does WordPress power?
